summary.en: Minesweeper with emoji standing in for mines — a few hundred lines of code, fun straight out of the box.
summary.zh: 把地雷换成 Emoji 的扫雷，几百行代码，开箱即玩。

description.en: Textbook Minesweeper: open cells, read the numbers for neighboring mines, right-click to flag the bombs, and clear every safe square to win.
description.zh: 经典扫雷规则：点开格子，数字表示周围雷数，右键标旗，清空所有非雷区域即胜利。

howto.en: Mouse — click to reveal, right-click to flag.

tip.en: The poster child for single-page mini-games: all logic lives in one HTML file. Swap the emoji for your mascot or brand icons and you have a custom Minesweeper at near-zero cost, with plenty of buzz.
tip.zh: 单页小游戏典范，全部逻辑在一个 HTML 文件里。可以把 Emoji 换成站点 IP 形象/品牌图标，做定制版扫雷，成本低、话题性强。
